target.title: Validate attention CLI color input
target.body:
Fixes #16
## Summary

Validate `nameplate attention --color` before writing the attention request.

Previously, the macOS CLI accepted any `--color` string and wrote it into the handoff JSON. Invalid values were only handled later by the app UI, which silently fell back to the identity color. That made scripts appear to succeed even when the requested alert color was ignored.

This change validates the value synchronously with `ColorHex.normalize`, fails fast for invalid input, and stores valid colors in normalized hex form.

## Validation

- `git diff --check`
- `swift build`

Behavior proof:

```text
HOME=/private/tmp/nameplate_cli_color_invalid_home .build/debug/NameplateCLI attention proof --color red
--color must be a 3- or 6-digit hex color

Exit code: 1
```
Confirmed no attention handoff file was created:

PROOF handoff-file-created=false
